movie_title: Making old things last longer - 6 Minute English
introduction: The world creates more than two billion tonnes of rubbish every year - shouldn't we start making it

vocabulary.definition: a very unpleasant or frightening experience
vocabulary.example: Today's been a nightmare! I ripped my jeans and later my computer stopped working!

vocabulary.definition: disposing of something as trash rather than reusing or repairing it
vocabulary.example: In today's consumer culture, when something breaks we usually throw it away and buy a new one, instead of trying to repair it.

vocabulary.definition: the ability to be maintained at a certain rate or level without depleting resources
vocabulary.example: Nudie Jeans was started with a focus on ethics and sustainability.

vocabulary.definition: the amount of carbon dioxide and other carbon compounds emitted due to the consumption of fossil fuels by a particular person, group, etc.
vocabulary.example: People in wealthy Sweden still buy lots of new stuff and they have a big carbon footprint for a country of just 10 million.

vocabulary.definition: at risk of extinction or harm
vocabulary.example: Jessika Richter thinks repairing is an endangered activity that we used to do more of.

vocabulary.definition: considered normal, common, or popular by the majority of people
vocabulary.example: She hopes fixing broken stuff will be mainstream, or be considered normal, once again.
